source: One actual random native .90 Hyper_CNN_512, no input checkpoint; oracle repair target measured before one simulated Avg

environment.new_process_precision: float32 models and original SVD/recovery; TF32 disabled, cuDNN benchmark false and deterministic true for all four arms; observations float64 CPU

unit_tests.skip_reason: Existing CUDA-only heterogeneous model/optimizer regression; CPU acceptance
checks: Actual per-layer integer ranks and gamma_j=count(r_i>=j)/tier_count, including rounded duplicate ranks
Independent segmented matrix formula and expected singular spectrum attenuation
Exactly three original pre-Avg SVDs and three shared E1/E2 download SVDs
No optimizer steps before the single simulated full Avg
Original full-parameter Avg equals independent weighted upload sum exactly
E2 uses same post-Avg P/Qh as E1, measured pre-Avg singular values, no gain cap
Original native E4 factors preserved exactly; E3 native factors preserved while common parameters aligned
Common nonfactor weights, classifier, bias and buffers verified
Nondefault seed and three-tier configuration with layer-specific rounding
Unchanged original CE+F trainer, single step/clip and read-only endpoint observation
Four cases use identical batch indices and training RNG
Fixed-epoch paired metric signs, duplicate/missing endpoint errors and complete no-checkpoint command

actual_CLI_synthetic_smoke.dataset: Independent N20 synthetic CIFAR-shaped NPZ fixture, audited without real-data edits

tolerance.criterion: Global max error <= atol+rtol*reference_max AND L2 error <= atol+rtol*reference_L2; no per-element allclose claim

limitations: No real pat20 run; synthetic accuracy is not evidence for repair/capacity gains
E2 repairs with oracle knowledge of measured pre-Avg spectra, not a proposed unknown-spectrum online estimator
E2 and E4 have different factor representations despite initially close functions; later SGD need not agree
E3 factor initialization is native, with specified common nonfactor parameter alignment; it is not an untouched independently headed small model
This local experiment does not establish preservation over future federated rounds or CUDA bitwise parity
